name: Craig Clayton
bio: Craig Clayton is a self-taught, Sr. iOS Engineer at Adept Mobile, which specializes in building mobile experiences primarily for NBA and NFL teams. He is the founder of Cocoa.academy, where he produces workshops and courses on iOS development. Craig is the author of the newly released book called iOS 10 Programming for Beginners. He has worked as a mentor for both adults and kids, helping those who aspire to become iOS developers.
